title: docs(skills): an approval's decision outputs are enforced at the decision in the automation skill
body:
domain:skills#1 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAnMUWA9rufXzFaEh4J _Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xXaMfp5V5DwGdQNfBzjZJEJ)_ Fixes #29512 Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none Fable mandate waived by the maintainer; contract review by triage. ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么:objectstack-automation 技能的审批参考文档现在教「审批节点声明的 `decisionOutputs` 在作出决定时被强制校验」:带类型的条目仍渲染对应选择器,同时 `type` 与 `multiple` 在同意和驳回时、任何写入之前都会检查;picker 值按 `expression` 审批人的解析器解析(`user` 任一账号的记录 id,`department` 本组织的记录 id,`team` 不属于别的组织的记录 id,`position` 本组织有人担任的岗位机器名);`multiple: true` 只收不重复的列表;其他非空值一律 `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` 并点名 `outputs.KEY`;Console 对 `multiple: true` 的文本输出发送列表。附 `@objectstack/skills` patch changeset。 - 为什么改:PR #29372(卡 #28658,裁决 A 6566731522)已把校验合入引擎,其 `Skills-docs:` 行欠下本卡;技能原文只说「带类型的条目渲染对应的记录选择器」,AI 写元数据时会以为 `type`/`multiple` 只影响界面。 - 风险与回滚:纯技能文本,无代码、无契约改动。token 天花板就地付账(删掉同一文件里已有原文的七处复述),上限行未动,无 re-wrap。回滚即 revert。 - 先看:`skills/objectstack-automation/references/state-machines-and-approvals.md` 的 *Recording a decision* 节新增段落,以及 Node Config 表的 `decisionOutputs` 行。 - 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期该文件 5724/5730,全绿。 - 需要你做的:Tier H 受管面(`skills/**`),需要 `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` 的批准;契约复审由 triage 做;PR 保持 draft。 ## What changes Facts are taken from current `main`, not the card text alone: `assertDecisionOutputsMatchDeclarations` and `decisionOutputValueRefusal` in `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts` (called before any write, on approve and reject), `content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx` → Dynamic approvers (as updated by #29371), and `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/decisionOutputParams.ts` (a `multiple: true` free-value output rides a `tags` param), pinned by `ActionParamDialog.decisionOutputList-28658.test.tsx`. Two files: `skills/objectstack-automation/references/state-machines-and-approvals.md` and its changeset. 1. **Recording a decision.** One new paragraph after the existing decision-outputs paragraph, which is byte-identical: a typed entry renders the matching picker in the decision dialog, and `type` and `multiple` are also enforced at the decision, on approve and reject alike, before any write. A picker value must resolve through the `expression` approver's resolvers, each scoped as the code scopes it: `user` by any account's record id (`reassignTargetRefusal(value, null)`), `department` by record id in the request's organization (`businessUnitIsLive`), `team` by record id not owned by another organization (`readTeamRow` + `teamOrganizationOf`), `position` by the machine name of a position someone in that organization holds (`expandPositionUsers`). `multiple: true` takes a list of distinct values (every kind, bare keys included); without it, one value. Any other non-blank value is `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` naming `outputs.KEY` (a blank value is left to `required`). The Console sends a list for a `multiple: true` text output. The paragraph points at the existing `lead_review` node (`{ key: 'next_reviewers', label: 'Next Reviewers', type: 'user', multiple: true, required: true }`) in the dynamic-approval flow as its example, so no second copy of the example is added. 2. **Node Config table, `decisionOutputs` row.** "a typed entry renders the matching record picker in the decision dialog (`multiple` collects an id array)" is replaced by "enforced at the decision — see *Recording a decision*". The declaration shape stays in the row. 3. **The dynamic-approval flow's comments.** The `lead_review` comment drops "The TYPED declaration renders a multi-select sys_user picker in the decision dialog" (the new paragraph keeps the picker fact) and keeps the `POST …/approve { outputs: { next_reviewers: ['u2', 'u3'] } }` line. The code itself is unchanged. 4. **`.changeset/29512-approval-decision-outputs-skill.md`.** `'@objectstack/skills': patch` with both declaration lines and a Before/Now body: `skills/**` ships byte for byte in `@objectstack/skills`, so the change publishes. ### Token ratchet, paid in place (no ceiling row moved, no re-wrap) | file | bytes before / after | tokens before / after / ceiling | lines before / after | |:--|:--|:--|:--| | `references/state-machines-and-approvals.md` | 22918 / 22894 | 5730 / 5724 / 5730 (headroom 0 → 6) | 392 / 399 | The new text is paid by deleting restated text whose home stays in the same file. Each deletion removes whole lines, a span of one table row, or a trailing comment. No surrounding line is reflowed: - `decisionOutputs` row: "(author declares, approvers fill values)" and "Accepted outputs resume the run as `.` variables; undeclared keys reject the decision; `decision`/`requestId` reserved". Home: *Recording a decision*, which states all four. - `lead_review` comment: "`required: true` is enforced by the runtime on APPROVE (never on reject) — node B below has nobody to route to without it." Home: *Recording a decision* ("A declaration marked `required: true` must carry a non-blank value to **approve** (never to reject) — enforced before any write …"). - `co_sign` comment: "Node B resolves them at entry from the lead's decision outputs." Home: example ② in *Dynamic approvers* ("The previous approval node's decision outputs pick this node's approvers") and the node's own `vars.lead_review.next_reviewers` approver. - `expression` row of Approver Types: "Only `current.*` / `trigger.*` / `vars.*` roots are available;". Home: the roots table directly below in *Dynamic approvers* ("Its CEL source sees exactly **three roots** — nothing else"). - The first example's three trailing comments, `// or 'unanimous' / 'quorum' / 'per_group'`, `// lock the record while pending` and `// mirror pending|approved|rejected|recalled onto the row`. Home: the Node Config table's `behavior`, `lockRecord` and `approvalStatusField` rows, which state each in full. The three keys and values stay. No repo test pins this file's text (`grep -rl state-machines-and-approvals packages ui/packages` finds nothing). ## Why PR #29372 (card #28658, ruling A 6566731522) made the approvals service judge each declared decision output at the decision, and its `Skills-docs:` line owed this card. The skill still described `type` and `multiple` as what the decision dialog renders, so an AI authoring an approval flow from it had no way to know that a mismatched value is refused with `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` before anything is written, that a `position` output takes a machine name and not a `sys_position` id, or that a `multiple: true` output refuses a repeated entry. ## Verification Head `a6110351` (four commits: d070954d the change, 1912f519 a one-phrase clarity fix, 597efdf4 the contract review's MF-1/SF-1/SF-2, a6110351 the changeset renamed and given the Before/Now shape). No code changed, so no package test, typecheck, ablation or dogfood battery is owed (`Clause-②: no`, no `!` in the title).
Local gates on a6110351: 43 derived, all 43 exit 0 (dispatch-gates --ran: 0 NOT-MEASURED) - `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 43 commands for the two changed files (the 33 of round 1 plus 10 changeset families: `check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` and its `--self-test`, `check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, `check-empty-changeset.mjs` and its `--self-test`, `release-rehearsal-clone.mjs --self-test`, `release-pending-publish.mjs --self-test`, `check:changeset-gate-self-tests`, `check:closed-ceremony-text`, `check:published-files`), the same list on 597efdf4 and a6110351. - All 43 ran in a tree with `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` (exit 0) and a full `pnpm build` (exit 0), each with a 900 s timeout, each exit code captured before any pipe. All 43 exited 0, among them `check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` (5724 of 5730), `check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:skill-refs`, `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:role-word`, `check:pm-governed-merges` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`. - `--ran` printed: `43 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 43 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. - `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD`: exit 0 (four commits, no card relation, model-free trailer pair). - Round 1 (1912f519): 33 derived, all 33 exit 0. CI on 1912f519: every check-run `success` or skipped by path filter or opt-in. CI on 597efdf4 was cancelled by the a6110351 push (its two aggregate jobs read `failure` over cancelled jobs). - Writes: `git push` ×5 (the bare branch pointer, d070954d, 1912f519, 597efdf4, a6110351); one relay `pr_create`; no GitHub MCP write.
## Acceptance notes - Round 2 answers the contract review of 1912f519 (comment 6606420300). MF-1: the changeset is added and the `skip-changeset` label is gone (the seat removed it). SF-1: the organization scope applies per kind, as the code scopes it. SF-2: the paragraph keeps that a typed entry renders the matching picker. The review's blank-value gap is closed by "any other non-blank value". - `content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx` carries the same "in the request's organization" overstatement for a `user` output. It is outside this PR's file surface and is the docs lane's follow-up, per the review. - No eval case was added. No eval in `skills/objectstack-automation/evals/**` covers `decisionOutputs` today, and the card asked for prose only. - The edit is made on the branch the platform fixes for this thread (`claude/project-thread-bo65kq`) in this container's own checkout, not in a sibling worktree, as on #29781. ## Human Minimum - [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No schema touched.) - [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. - [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` is CI's repo-wide run. - [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request. - [x] 5. The change publishes `@objectstack/skills`, so it carries a `patch` changeset; both declaration lines are in the PR body and the changeset. - [x] 6. `packages/spec` not touched. - [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`. - [x] 8.
